articles.title: Toem 2 Hands-On: A Delightful Photography Sim That Turns Errands into Joy
articles.summary: Toem 2 builds on the original's charm with a new 'Friend' system and screwdriver puzzles. Set in a cozy riverside town, it turns mundane tasks like plumbing fixes into a relaxing, tourist-like experience full of quirky characters and photo ops.

articles.title: Netflix's June 2026 Slate: From 'Poor Things' to 'Bee Movie,' a Wild Mix
articles.summary: Netflix's June lineup spans Oscar-winner 'Poor Things,' classic rom-coms, the 'Creed' trilogy, and family fare like 'Sesame Street.' New originals 'Office Romance' and 'Voicemails for Isabelle' anchor a month of diverse streaming options.

articles.title: Steam Deck Gets a Hefty Price Hike as Valve Joins Industry Trend
articles.summary: Valve has raised Steam Deck prices by $200 or more, with the 512GB OLED model now $789. The move follows similar hikes by Sony, Nintendo, and Microsoft, though Valve leans on Steam's frequent sales and no online fees to soften the blow.
